comparison.objective: Make one dent at the center of a scribed cross with an automatic center punch.
comparison.physical_skill: Precisely align and axially press a self-firing punch while preventing tip skate, tilt, and lateral loading.
comparison.success_condition: One centered mark, punch lifted clear and held still; off-center, tilted, or repeated firing is unacceptable. No separate spec version supplies numeric thresholds.
comparison.reason: This shares narrow-tool alignment and axial-force regulation, but creates a single surface indentation through an internal punch mechanism. It has no separate hammer, bimanual tool stabilization, component fracture, retained-coil constraint, or debris recovery.
